facts.fact: Before the whole hall, including Captain Haran and the crown sergeants, Queen Nirmala answers Neela's record of the raids with a plain 'Yes': the raids made her knives.
Neela declares the four remaining crown-leaf pages are the four guards' to ask for and says she will sign no charter that leaves them in the crown's hand, ending the queen's leverage over the pages.
Chathu's tin of warm sweets reached Neela by palace post, kept warm 'as ordered' by the column's last rider; who ordered it warmed is unexplained.
Captain Haran's three hundred crown spears hold the cut beside the Company under the queen's word, and the three-day truce is set to run out in three days.
